_comment: Tunable numbers. Every value is optional; see BalanceDef / DifficultyDef for defaults. Difficulty presets apply on top of the base numbers. Party XP: enemies give xpByTier[tier] (or their own 'xp'); levelXp[i] is the total XP for level i+1; each level, every living hero picks +levelUpHp max HP, a card upgrade or a card removal (never below minDeckSize).

prices._comment: Merchant. Cards by rarity; removal and upgrade are once per visit; itemStock = copies of each item.

easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Tougher heroes, softer foes, heal after each win.

hard.name: Hard
hard.description: Foes are tougher, hit harder and more often.
